LESSON: READING POSTURE

Grade: PP1
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: READING
Topic 3.6: Reading Posture

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Reading Posture. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What is appropriate Posture learner should be able to: correct reading posture after observing a reading posture?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Demonstrate appropriate demonstration on sitting properly when picture 2.
2. Identify correct reading poems and rhymes related to appropriate reading postures in pictures or in class. posture
3. Identify incorrect reading • Learners could be exposed to models of correct postures in pictures or in class. reading posture

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: READING POSTURE
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES · Grade: PP1
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Reading Posture helps you succeed in LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

KEY FACTS: READING POSTURE
Language skills grow by daily practice: listen carefully, speak clearly, read every day, write neatly.
Model → guided practice → independent practice.
Always use complete sentences when writing answers.

PART 1: Demonstrate appropriate demonstration on sitting properly when picture 2.

What this means
In this part you learn to Demonstrate appropriate demonstration on sitting properly when picture 2.. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: Demonstrate appropriate demonstration on sitting properly when picture 2..
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model reading: Read a short paragraph about “Reading Posture”, then retell it in 3 sentences.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can Demonstrate appropriate demonstration on sitting properly when picture 2.. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Identify correct reading poems and rhymes related to appropriate reading postures in pictures or in class. posture

What this means
In this part you learn to Identify correct reading poems and rhymes related to appropriate reading postures in pictures or in class. posture. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: Identify correct reading poems and rhymes related to appropriate reading postures in pictures or in class. posture.
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model speaking: Say 4 clear sentences about Reading Posture to a partner.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can Identify correct reading poems and rhymes related to appropriate reading postures in pictures or in class. posture. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Identify incorrect reading • Learners could be exposed to models of correct postures in pictures or in class. reading posture

What this means
In this part you learn to Identify incorrect reading • Learners could be exposed to models of correct postures in pictures or in class. reading posture. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: Identify incorrect reading • Learners could be exposed to models of correct postures in pictures or in class. reading posture.
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model writing: Write 5 neat sentences using new words from this lesson.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can Identify incorrect reading • Learners could be exposed to models of correct postures in pictures or in class. reading posture. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Reading Posture is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Read a short paragraph about “Reading Posture”, then retell it in 3 sentences. (skill: Demonstrate appropriate demonstration on sitting properly when picture 2.)

Example 2: Say 4 clear sentences about Reading Posture to a partner. (skill: Identify correct reading poems and rhymes related to appropriate reading postures in pictures or in class. posture)

Example 3: Write 5 neat sentences using new words from this lesson. (skill: Identify incorrect reading • Learners could be exposed to models of correct postures in pictures or in class. reading posture)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Reading Posture to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: Demonstrate appropriate demonstration on sitting properly when picture 2..
3. Practise this skill: Identify correct reading poems and rhymes related to appropriate reading postures in pictures or in class. posture.
4. Practise this skill: Identify incorrect reading • Learners could be exposed to models of correct postures in pictures or in class. reading posture.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Reading Posture from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Reading Posture: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a PP1 learner study Reading Posture?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What is appropriate Posture learner should be able to: correct reading posture after observing a reading posture?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Reading Posture means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: Demonstrate appropriate demonstration on sitting properly when picture 2..
5. Be able to: Identify correct reading poems and rhymes related to appropriate reading postures in pictures or in class. posture.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
